name: ruff-term
description: Ruff Term - an internal market data terminal

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=@ruff-term/server & npm run dev --workspace=@ruff-term/web & wait
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@ruff-term/server && npm run build --workspace=@ruff-term/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@ruff-term/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@ruff-term/web
